'''Sarka''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sarkan/Legends|Sarkan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
Sarka was inhabited by a variety of animals, [[Plant/Legends|plants]], and [[Insect/Legends|insects]], including Sarkans, the planet's only [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species.<ref name="TTS" />

[[File:Sarkan2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A group of Sarkans]]
The terrain of Sarka was dominated by [[Water/Legends|humid]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] and marshland. [[Cave/Legends|Cave]] systems, usually located adjacent to underground hot springs, housed most of the planet's population and were rich with [[Nova ruby|nova rubies]], which were highly valued throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TTS" /> Five major [[Language/Legends|languages]] were spoken on the planet, including [[Sarkese/Legends|Sarkese]].

==History==
{{Quote|There's more to these attacks than simple harassment, Captain. Once this group has told their story, all future convoys from Sarka will demand upgraded protection. Enough such attacks, and the Rebellion will face the choice of either tying up large numbers of its ships with escort duty or effectively abandoning cargo shipment through these border sectors.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
Sarkan ambassadors were among the most powerful political groups in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TTS" /> and the planet was the site of a Republic supply center which was [[Raid on Sarka|targeted]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] campaign.<ref name="DFR" />

Sarka was attacked and [[Battle of the Sarka system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] between [[26 ABY/Legends|26]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Sarka in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
